item.title: Cottonwood man accused of raping elderly neighbor will spend life behind bars
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- A Cottonwood man accused of raping his elderly neighbor has been ordered to spend the rest of his life behind bars. item.title: US applications for jobless benefits jump by 22,000 to 231,000 last week, the most in 2 months.
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The number of Americans applying for unemployment benefits jumped last week but remains in the same historically low range of the past few years. item.title: Five takeaways on the search for Savannah Guthrie's mother
item.description: Law enforcement provided new details on Thursday in the search for Nancy Guthrie, the 84-year-old mother of the “Today” show co-anchor Savannah Guthrie who went missing from her home this weekend in what officials believe to be an abduction.
